BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to teacher retention in rural school districts; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that recentresearch by the University of Washington sheds light on teacherretention, attrition, and mobility in Washington. The researchattempted to identify statewide and district patterns of teacherbehavior based on twenty sample districts. Despite some variation inthe district sample based on geographic region and size, however,additional analysis and a more complete data set are necessary to makevalid findings for small and rural school districts in the state. (2) The University of Washington shall continue its research onteacher retention, attrition, and mobility and complete a study thatexamines trends and patterns of teacher behavior in small and ruralschool districts as compared to large and urban school districts. Theuniversity shall submit the study findings to the education committeesof the legislature by December 1, 2006.
